theme_and_archetype.archetype: Editorial / Old Money Tech (Custom variant based on user constraints)
theme_and_archetype.description: The tone, direction and style target seasoned/emerging executives and NEDs. Look and feel: editorial cream/oxblood/serif aesthetic. Direct, confident, NACD/IoD/FT register. No SaaS fluff.

background.usage: Primary page background, cards, header background

accents.oxblood_usage: Secondary CTAs, subtle active states, subtle borders, high-impact numbers/rubrics
accents.executive_navy_usage: Primary CTA buttons, quote attribution chips, Enterprise 'Decks + Reports' section full-width background

headlines.usage: Hero H1, Section H2, Pull Quotes, Feature Titles. Sentence case, left-aligned.

body_and_chrome.usage: Body text, small captions, top navigation, button text, labels.

navy_accent_placement_strategy.primary_ctas: All 'Try AKKI in 60 seconds' (Sandbox) buttons must have bg-[#0A1F44] text-[#F7F3EA].
navy_accent_placement_strategy.quote_attribution: Author names and titles in pull quotes should be rendered in the navy #0A1F44 to pop against the cream background without fighting the oxblood.
navy_accent_placement_strategy.enterprise_section: The 'Decks + Reports' section should use a full-width #0A1F44 background. Text inside this section should be cream #F7F3EA. This breaks up the page and signals 'Enterprise/Secure' heavily.

three_pillar_visual_system.layout: Bento-style or asymmetrical grid. Avoid repetitive identical cards. Direct the eye to the strongest feature (Solve).
three_pillar_visual_system.solve_pillar: The Hero Feature. Takes up 2 columns or is prominent at the top of the grid. Uses the desk/ledgers image. Clear 'Start Session' CTA.
three_pillar_visual_system.pulse_pillar: Secondary focus. Emphasize aggregation and 'Cross-board' patterns. Uses the library/books image. Focus on data points.
three_pillar_visual_system.decks_reports_pillar: Enterprise focus. Extracted to its own full-width navy band below the grid, or as a dense, high-contrast block within the bento. Uses columns architecture image.

copy.headline: AKKI reads the pack so you can read the room.
copy.subhead: The unified workspace for seasoned and emerging executives to grow and preserve shareholder value.

section_architecture.visual_treatment: Left-aligned Georgia headline (text-5xl or 6xl). Right side or background: sepia-duotone boardroom image with cream overlay blending.

copy.solve_headline: Diagnose board-grade problems in one structured pause.
solve_bullets: Export to Brief or PDF in one click
pulse_bullets: Aggregate signals, themes, and risk patterns
Catch systemic risks before the audit chair

section_architecture.visual_treatment: Asymmetrical layout. Large Solve section with 'Start Session' secondary CTA. Smaller Pulse section.
Full-bleed Navy (#0A1F44) background. Cream text. High contrast, signaling enterprise security.

section_architecture.purpose: Provide trust via FT-style editorial tone

copy.quote: Adopting tools that preserve value isn't just operational—it is a fiduciary duty.

section_architecture.visual_treatment: Massive Georgia serif pull-quote. Attribution chip in Navy. Accent line in Oxblood.

copy_library.bullet_style: Short, punchy, active verbs. No paragraphs longer than 2 sentences.

mobile_responsive_considerations.hero: Stack text above image on mobile. Ensure headline scales down nicely (text-4xl).
mobile_responsive_considerations.bento_grid: Collapse to 1 column on mobile. Keep order: Solve -> Pulse -> Decks.
mobile_responsive_considerations.padding: Maintain generous padding (py-16 md:py-24) to keep the luxurious editorial feel.

media_urls.description: Empty boardroom with leather chairs. Apply CSS sepia duotone filter (e.g. mix-blend-multiply with #8B2E2B, or grayscale sepia filters).
Old books library. Apply CSS sepia duotone treatment.
Neoclassical columns architecture. Apply CSS sepia duotone treatment.
